common_premise: Fixed R built-in valid battle/Pokemon/data objects, supported existing layout, no plugin or concurrent mutation. Complete listed CORE/Battler files personally read. Foreign facts have original reader credit and retain their own complete premises. SOURCE_STATIC only.
common_cancel: Only reached ordinary branches asserted. Earlier rejection or callback failure can prevent later writes and messages. A query is not an action or successful scene return.
common_failure: Writes follow source order without transaction rollback. Local field writes can precede bound Pokemon setter errors; scene callbacks can fail after earlier local/persistent changes. Whole branch completion is conditional on all reached calls returning normally.
common_persistence: Battle-local seat/order/effect/choice state is distinguished from aliased Pokemon persistent fields. No serialization/reload is certified by a local write or received source fact.
